protocol_type: Two-wire current-loop sensor telegram protocol. The sensor transmits Manchester-coded telegrams to the ECU by current modulation on the two-wire current loop; the ECU powers the loop and (in synchronous mode) emits a sync pulse to trigger time-slot transmission.

channels.name: Two-wire current loop (line A / line B)
channels.direction: ECU -> sensor power; sensor -> ECU data (current modulation)
channels.description: The same two wires supply power to the sensor and carry the sensor data. The sensor modulates its supply current (nominal +-26 mA) to send Manchester-coded telegrams; the ECU senses the loop current to receive them.

channels.name: Sync pulse (on the two-wire supply)
channels.description: In synchronous mode the ECU applies a voltage pulse on the supply to trigger the sensor(s) to transmit in defined time slots.

telegram_format.start_condition: Start bits marking the beginning of the telegram so the ECU can detect the start of a Manchester-coded data word.
telegram_format.data_bits: Manchester-coded sensor data bits (the measurement word); the data word length is configurable.
telegram_format.region_status_bits: Optional bits carrying region/range or status information.
telegram_format.error_check: A 2-bit CRC, a 3-bit CRC, or a parity bit, depending on the configured data word length.
telegram_format.transmission: The telegram is sent as Manchester-coded current pulses on the two-wire current loop, from start condition to CRC/parity.

error_check_field.selection_rule: Short data words use a parity bit or a 2-bit CRC; longer data words use a 3-bit CRC.

operating_modes.synchronous: ECU sync pulse triggers the sensor(s) to transmit in defined time slots (time-division on a parallel bus).
operating_modes.asynchronous: Sensor transmits telegrams autonomously without a sync pulse.

addressing.note: PSI5 has no explicit per-frame address; on a parallel bus in synchronous mode, sensors are distinguished by their assigned TIME SLOT relative to the ECU sync pulse, not by an address field.

frame_format.line_coding: Manchester (mid-bit transition per bit; embedded bit clock).
frame_format.physical: current modulation on a two-wire current loop (nominal +-26 mA pulses).
frame_format.framing: Telegram = start condition + Manchester data bits + optional region/status bits + 2-bit/3-bit CRC or parity.
